_about: Per-block corrections from Street View (look-only), applied by tools/build-markings.mjs over what the open data gives. Keys are NYC Centerline physical ids. parkL/parkR: parking lanes on the left/right of the segment's drawing direction; parkLine: a solid white line along each parking lane; bike: 'L' or 'R' forces a curbside bike lane on that side; sv: Street View capture month checked.

91629.name: Washington Sq N, Fifth Av to Washington Sq W
91629.note: From the park: green curbside bike lane, hatched buffer, one travel lane, parking on the building side with a solid white line. The centreline data says two parking lanes.

91622.name: Washington Sq S, Washington Sq W to Thompson St
91622.note: Bike lane and buffer on the park side, one travel lane, parking on the building side only.

91625.name: Washington Sq S, to Washington Sq E

1853.name: Washington Sq E
1853.note: Curbside bike lane along the park, one travel lane, no parking on either side.

101325.name: Washington Sq W (MacDougal St at the park)
101325.note: Bike lane along the park curb, one travel lane, no parking.

1450.name: LaGuardia Pl, W 3rd St to Washington Sq S
1450.note: Two-way, double yellow, one lane each way, parking both sides with solid white parking lines. Matches the data otherwise.

2021.name: Fifth Av, Washington Sq N to E 8th St
2021.note: Southbound; parking on the west side, hatched buffer and parking on the east side; matches the generated layout.

80061.name: University Pl, Washington Sq N to E 8th St
80061.note: Northbound; parking on the west side; a Citi Bike station fills the east parking lane (in the GBFS data). Matches.

16746.name: W 4th St, Washington Sq E to Greene St
16746.note: Construction barriers along the Stern frontage took the south lane in Apr 2026; the permanent layout (one lane, bike lane, parking) is kept.
